svg.text: Layer 1 — Existing LMS Core (Unchanged) · Multi-Tenant Kubernetes on Nutanix HCI

g.data-tip: LMS Core — Multi-tenant Kubernetes. Each university in its own namespace. REST APIs for content, progress, assessments. Keycloak JWT tenant context propagated to all AI calls. No changes to LMS core — AI added as a separate layer.
Keycloak JWT — Tenant context (university_id, role, course_id) propagated to every AI microservice call. Per-tenant data isolation enforced at every layer.

76 Universities · 1M+ Learners — Each university namespace-isolated. Single Glue Data Catalog with tenant_id-based row-level isolation. Custom domain + branded landing per tenant. Shared AI infrastructure, isolated data.
REST APIs — Content upload, progress tracking, assessment submission. Existing APIs unchanged. New AI microservices subscribe to events via SQS/EventBridge without modifying LMS code.

Jenkins CI/CD + AIMS/ISO 42001 — Every AI model invocation logged with: model version, cost, reviewer action, tenant_id. Full audit trail for compliance. Human-in-loop decisions logged as structured events.

svg.text: Layer 2 — AI Service Mesh (ai-services namespace) · 7 Independent Microservices · Each HPA-scaled

g.data-tip: Content Gen Orchestrator → Bedrock Claude 3 — Generates course summaries, quiz questions, learning objectives, and module descriptions from faculty-provided materials. Bedrock Guardrails: prompt injection + PII screening.

Audio Synthesis → Amazon Polly Neural TTS — Converts text content to MP3 audio in 8 Indian languages: en-IN, hi-IN, ta-IN, te-IN, bn-IN, mr-IN, kn-IN, gu-IN. SSML for pronunciation and prosody. Audio stored in S3 with Standard→IA→Glacier lifecycle. Accessibility for visually-impaired learners and mobile/offline study.

Video Transcription → Transcribe + Step Functions — Async transcription job: StartTranscriptionJob with Indian language support and speaker diarization. Step Functions video enrichment pipeline: Rekognition moderation → Transcribe → WebVTT captions → chunk → embed → index → SNS notify faculty.

Translation → Translate + Custom Terminology — AWS Translate with Custom Terminology CSV. Domain terms (ICAR agricultural vocabulary, regional university names, course codes) that must NOT be translated are protected. Batch translation via S3. Human-in-loop review before publication for translated content.

Recommendation Engine → SageMaker — Personalised learning path model trained on learner engagement signals. Deployed as SageMaker managed Endpoint. A/B tested with Shadow Variants. Clarify for bias detection. Drift monitoring on prediction confidence.

Video Moderation → Rekognition — StartContentModeration at 80% confidence threshold. Pre-publication screening for violence, explicit content, and unsafe imagery. Every moderation result logged for AIMS/ISO 42001 audit. Faculty SNS notification on flag. Configurable threshold per tenant.

RAG Gateway → Bedrock KB + OpenSearch Serverless — Powers "Ask My Course" feature. Chunks with video timestamps enable jump-to-moment citations. Bedrock Knowledge Bases API. OpenSearch Serverless HNSW + BM25 hybrid. Tenant-scoped retrieval via Keycloak JWT.

svg.text: Layer 3 — Step Functions Video Enrichment Pipeline

g.data-tip: Step 1: S3 Upload → EventBridge → Step Function starts. Video in raw zone, status=PENDING.
Step 2: Rekognition StartContentModeration — 80% confidence. Pass → continue; Flag → SNS to faculty review queue.
Step 3: Transcribe StartTranscriptionJob — Indian lang + speaker diarization. Timestamped JSON → s3://lms-processed/
Step 4: Lambda generates WebVTT captions from transcript. Attaches to LMS video via REST API. status=CAPTIONED.
Step 5: Transcript chunked 300–500 tokens with course_id + timestamp_range metadata. Enables "jump to moment" citations in RAG responses.
Step 6: Titan Embeddings v2 vectorises chunks. Bulk-indexed to OpenSearch Serverless via Bedrock KB API. Video semantically searchable by meaning + timestamp.
Step 7: SNS notifies faculty — captioned, transcribed, indexed. LMS status=PUBLISHED. Video live with captions and semantic search.

svg.text: Layer 4 — Async Backbone + S3 Multi-Zone Storage

g.data-tip: Amazon SQS — Human-in-loop review queue. All AI-generated quizzes, summaries, and translated content queued for faculty approval before publication. FIFO for ordered review. DLQ for failed review items.

S3 Multi-Zone — lms-raw (original uploads), lms-processed (transcripts, Parquet, Textract JSON), lms-curated (AI content pending review), lms-audio (MP3: Standard→IA→Glacier lifecycle). CloudFront CDN signed URL delivery. Per-tenant KMS CMK encryption.
Amazon SNS — Faculty notifications: task completion (transcribed/translated/captioned), moderation flags, budget alerts. SES email notifications for course enrollment events.
Amazon EventBridge — Routes S3 upload events to Step Functions. Starts AI pipelines on course content events. Central event bus coordinating all async AI workflows.
CloudWatch Custom Dimensions — tenant_id + course_id on every AI invocation. X-Ray distributed tracing. Grafana per-university dashboards. AWS Budgets per-tenant caps.
Bedrock Guardrails — Prompt injection detection and PII output screening on all AI calls. Applied before and after generation. Configurable per use case and tenant.

IAM Tenant-Scoped Roles + KMS CMKs — Each university has its own IAM role and KMS CMK. Cross-tenant data access structurally impossible. VPC PrivateLink: no public internet exposure for any AWS service.
g.text: IAM Tenant Roles · KMS CMKs · PrivateLink
Per-tenant encryption · VPC PrivateLink (no public internet)

g.data-tip: AIMS/ISO 42001 Audit Trail — Every AI invocation logged: model version, cost, reviewer action (approved/rejected/modified), tenant_id, correlation_id. Human-in-loop decisions are structured audit events. Required for national LMS compliance.
